verdict.rationale: Whisper is a speech-to-text model and API, not an agent, so an official MCP server would be a plausible offering and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only the transcription API, the OpenAI CLI, the pip package/CLI and the Python API. None of it mentions an MCP server or endpoint. The llms.txt probe is a documentation index, not an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
